mission: Ship @beep/freshbooks on the hubspot pattern: rotation-safe token helper, clients/invoices/payments reads, and spike-gated invoice-PDF retrieval
statusNote: 2026-09-03: closed via PR #987 (driven to mergeable with yeet). Shipped: @beep/freshbooks with single-refresh-owner token rotation (concurrent-refresh proof), schema-decoded identity/clients/invoices/payments read verbs over distinct account_id/business_id namespaces, and the P0 spike report (request limits, webhook retry schedule). Not shipped: the invoice-PDF verb stays out per SPEC because its live validation needs a one-time operator OAuth grant (redirect-URI registration + Authorize consent) an agent cannot perform; the ready harness is research/live-spike-harness.md and the operator-export fallback is recorded in the closeout reflection.

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until this goal's work ships as a PR driven to mergeable via /yeet (bun run beep yeet: repair -> verify -> publish --pr -> monitor).
